scope: Installed PostgreSQL migration Apply on Kubernetes 1.37, with two manager replicas and default 10Mi kubelet logs. One successful HTTP acknowledgment was lost after durable receipt persistence; the original Pod resent identical bytes and received the same receipt. A nontransactional sequence and committed row both remained at one before and after releasing the retry. This is not duplicate-concurrent-request, receiver-restart, MySQL, or complete supported-minor proof.
